data.body_html:
Planning a hen party in Marbella for 2029? A private yacht charter is the ultimate way to celebrate, combining luxury, privacy, and stunning Costa del Sol views. This complete cost breakdown covers every boat option, what's included, and what you'll actually pay — no hidden fees, no surprises. From budget-friendly 2-hour trips to all-day luxury on a 24m Mangusta, here's your honest 2029 budget guide.

Why Choose a Yacht for Your Hen Party in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline is made for celebrations. With 320 days of sunshine a year, average summer temperatures of 28°C, and the glamorous Puerto Banús as your departure point, a yacht offers a private, flexible party venue. You control the music, the itinerary, and the vibe — swim stops at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, champagne on the flybridge, or a sunset cruise past the Golden Mile. No crowded bars, no fixed schedules.

2029 Hen Party Yacht Prices: Tier A (Budget-Friendly)

Our most popular hen party options are the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. Prices are fixed for 2029:

  • 2 hours: €749
  • 4 hours: €1,299
  • 6 hours: €1,899
  • 8 hours: €2,299

These are all-inclusive — no extra charges for skipper, fuel, or taxes. Perfect for a shorter celebration or if you're on a tighter budget.

2029 Hen Party Yacht Prices: Tier B (Luxury)

For a larger group or a more extravagant experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is the flagship choice. It comes with a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. This includes everything in Tier A plus the jet ski — ideal for bridesmaids who want to hit the water in style. The same applies to the grey variant (Mangusta 80 Grey).

Other luxury boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) are available on request — contact us via WhatsApp for pricing.

What's Included in Every Charter (No Hidden Costs)

Every hen party yacht charter from Boat Rental Marbella includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • 21% Spanish IVA (VAT)

No extra charges for cleaning, docking, or crew gratuity (though tips are appreciated). You can bring your own decorations, cake, or music — just let us know in advance.

Optional Extras & Their Costs

Want to upgrade? We can arrange:

  • Catering: Paella, BBQ, or canapés — quoted per person
  • DJ or sound system: From €200
  • Photographer/videographer: From €350
  • Decorations: Balloons, banners, or themed setups — from €100
  • Private chef: On request

All extras are quoted via WhatsApp — no pressure, just a clear price before you decide.

How to Budget for a 2029 Hen Party Yacht in Marbella

Here's a sample budget for a group of 10 on the Azimut 39 (11 pax max):

ItemCostPer Person (10 pax)
4-hour charter (all-inclusive)€1,299€130
Catering (paella + drinks upgrade)€400€40
Decorations + cake€150€15
Photographer (2 hours)€350€35
Total€2,199€220

For a luxury option on the Mangusta 80 (12 pax), a 4-hour charter costs €4,719 (€393 per person) with the jet ski included — no extra activity cost.

Booking Tips for 2029

Peak season (June to September) books out fast, especially for hen parties. Secure your date with a deposit at least 2-3 months in advance. All bookings are confirmed via WhatsApp with a clear invoice. For more details, see our Marbella yacht charter hub for the full fleet and availability.
